cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 07.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality
cl.x: The substrate must offer sufficient strength and adhesion to resist the forces generated by wind suction.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: The substrate must be firm, clean, dry or slightly moist, free from oil, grease, dust, stripping agents, standing water, bitumen residue and loose friable particles.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 07.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Consumption
tr: Consumption depends on the roughness and absorbency of the substrate. Recommended consumption of Sarnacol®-2142 S on different substrates (+20 °C / 50 % r.h. )
These figures are theoretical and do not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level or wastage etc.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application
cl.x: Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application > General information
s: Sarnacol®-2142 S must be stirred carefully before use. Keep adhesive container closed whenever adhesive is not being used to prevent surface skinning.
To improve the workability of the adhesive at low temperatures, the closed container can be placed in warm water (max. +40 °C).
Adhesive residue on Sikaplan® SGK must be cleaned with SikaRoof® Cleaner L-100. Adhesive residue on Sarnafil® T Felt, must be cleaned with Sarnafil® T Clean.

cl.t: Application - General bonding procedure - Wet bonding
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application > General bonding procedure - Wet bonding
cl.x: The adhesive is spread evenly onto the substrate by using a synthetic application roller directly from the container and ensuring there are no lumps in the applied layers.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application > Bonding Membranes
cl.x: Apply adhesive onto the substrate. Do not apply the adhesive to an area greater than can be covered within 15 minutes. Do not pour out the adhesive and roll in a second stage. Once the adhesive surface has become 'tacky', apply the membrane onto the adhesive. Press down firmly on the membrane using a suitable pressure roller such as a water-filled, or heavy steel roller 40 – 50 kg.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with Sarnafil® T Clean immediately after use. Hardened material can only be mechanically removed.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Considerations
s: The use of some ancillary products such as adhesives, cleaners and solvents is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Observe temperature limitations in the appropriate Product Data Sheets.
Special measures may be compulsory for installation below +5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.
